description: Source code for the 'Documents' module in vtiger CRM, defining the Documents class with methods for handling document records, attachments, exports, and report queries.

classes.name: Documents
classes.description: Represents the Documents module in vtiger CRM, handling document data, attachments, export, and report query functionalities.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Saves or updates a document record, handling file uploads and attachment associations.

methods.name: insertIntoAttachment
methods.description: Uploads and saves file attachments related to a document.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Retrieves the sort order for listing documents.

methods.name: getOrderBy
methods.description: Retrieves the order by column for listing documents.

methods.name: getSortOrderForFolder
methods.description: Gets the sort order for documents within a specific folder.

methods.name: getOrderByForFolder
methods.description: Gets the order by column for documents within a specific folder.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Builds the SQL query to export documents in CSV format.

methods.name: del_create_def_folder
methods.description: Ensures default folder exists for documents without a folder.

methods.name: insertintonotesrel
methods.description: Creates a relationship between a note and another entity.

methods.name: generateReportsQuery
methods.description: Builds the primary SQL query for report generation.

methods.name: generateReportsSecQuery
methods.description: Builds the secondary SQL query for related modules in reports.

methods.name: setRelationTables
methods.description: Returns relation tables for related modules.

methods.name: unlinkDependencies
methods.description: Unlinks all dependent entities of a document.

methods.name: unlinkRelationship
methods.description: Removes relationship between a document and another entity.

methods.name: getFileTypeFieldName
methods.description: Retrieves the field name for the file type attribute.

methods.name: getFile_FieldName
methods.description: Retrieves the field name for the file upload attribute.

methods.name: isFolderPresent
methods.description: Checks if a folder exists by folder ID.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores a document record, re-linking to default folder if necessary.

methods.name: getQueryByModuleField
methods.description: Modifies a query for specific module and field conditions, e.g., MailManager.
